ai.welcome_message: I can answer questions using this child's logged nutrition, sleep, activity, and clinical data. I'm not a doctor — for diagnosis or treatment decisions, bring the trend data on the Analytics tab to your pediatrician.What would you like to know?
analytics.bmi.info: BMI-for-age, from the most recent measurement, using the WHO 2007 Reference (5–19 years). Amber mark = overweight cutoff (+1SD), red mark = obesity cutoff (+2SD). A screening signal, not a diagnosis — BMI can't distinguish muscle from fat.
analytics.charts.bmi_note: BMI-for-age, using WHO's official reference for this child's current age. A screening signal, not a diagnosis — BMI can't distinguish muscle from fat, which matters most for very active children.
analytics.charts.growth_note: Shaded bands are the official WHO 2007 Growth Reference for school-age children and adolescents (5–19 years), transcribed directly from who.int. This is a population reference, not a diagnosis — bring this chart to your pediatrician for clinical interpretation, especially near the band edges.

today.nutrition.note: Preset food values are per-100g USDA FoodData Central figures, scaled to a typical portion — real servings vary. Tap a card to add its protein/zinc to today's total; long-press (or right-click) to subtract a misclick. Tap "Browse more foods" to choose which cards show here, or add your own food with your own estimated values.

today.sleep.gh_note: Most of a child's daily growth hormone release happens in the first deep-sleep cycle, roughly 60–90 minutes after sleep onset. Going to bed on time matters more than total hours.

flutter.coach.sleep_low: Sleep is the highest-leverage factor (40% of readiness). Aim for bedtime before 21:30 — most growth hormone is released in the first deep-sleep window.
flutter.coach.activity_low: Add high-impact activity — jumping, basketball, skipping. 60 weighted minutes fills the ring; high-impact counts at full value.

flutter.coach.calcium_gap: Calcium is at {n}% of the 1300 mg target — milk, cheese or tofu close the gap fast.
flutter.coach.all_good: Great day — all three systems are on track. Keep the streak going.
